name: test-full
note: TEST ONLY, never shipped (scripts/ is not an app resource; a core test checks that). Used by scripts/e2e-hello-mint.sh to prove the READY path on a developer machine that lacks aderyn and medusa: both are fetched from the upstream release named in components/toolchain-bundle.json for this platform into a scratch tools directory, the sha256 is checked against the measured value there, and the real binaries are run. Nothing about the gate changes: the same parsers judge the same raw outputs.
